title: Cross-Industry LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) Record — Shared Base
description: Shared base evidence model for Lockout/Tagout (LOTO, 잠금/표지) records across high-risk industries. Derived from psm-loto-record.json (the most complete domain-specific LOTO model). Domain-specific provisions go in industry_specific_fields. Dedicated domain models (e.g., psm-loto-record.json) are preserved for domain-specific procedures and remain authoritative for their respective domains.

industry_profile.description: Industry profile determines the legal_basis template and industry_specific_fields schema

lock_date.description: Date the LOTO permit was issued / lock applied.

lock_timestamp.description: Exact date-time when the lock was first applied.

equipment_tag.description: Identifier of the equipment being isolated (equipment_id / equipment_tag).

equipment_description.description: Human-readable description of the equipment and its location.

energy_sources.description: Hazardous energy source types isolated for this LOTO.

description.description: Description of the specific energy source (e.g., '480V motor MCC-3', 'steam at 150psi').

magnitude.description: Energy magnitude if applicable (e.g., '480VAC/3ph', '150 psig', '350 C').

isolation_points.description: Isolation points (locks/tags) applied for this LOTO, supporting multiple simultaneous locks (Group LOTO). Per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §6.2, the tag must remain attached to the lock and identify the person, work window, and contact information.

point_id.description: Identifier of the isolation point (e.g., breaker, valve, disconnect).

location.description: Physical location of the isolation point.

lock_applied_by.description: Name or ID of the person who applied the lock at this isolation point.

lock_id.description: Unique identifier of the lock applied at this isolation point.

contact_info.description: Contact information for the person who applied the lock, as required on the tag (꼬리표) per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §3.5 and §6.2.

timestamp.description: Date and time the lock was applied.

locks_applied.description: Total number of locks applied across all isolation points.

group_isolation.description: Present when this LOTO uses group isolation locking (그룹잠금) per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §3.4 — 2+ isolation points or 2+ work teams (e.g., multi-contractor TAR). Null under personal_lock or individual_locking.

group_leader_id.description: ID of the group isolation leader responsible for coordinating all locks.

group_lock_list.description: List of all lock_ids included in this group isolation.

verification.description: Zero-energy verification record. Per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §6.1.3, verification must confirm zero-energy state before work begins.

verified_zero_energy.description: Confirms zero-energy state was verified before work began.

verified_by.description: Name or ID of the person who confirmed zero-energy state.

verification_method.description: Method used to verify zero-energy state.

supervisor_confirmed.description: 관리감독자 (supervisor) confirmed lock/tag safety measures are in place, per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §5.2.

supervisor_id.description: ID of the supervisor who confirmed.

removal.description: Lock/tag removal record. Per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §6.1.4/§8.5, only the person who applied a given lock may remove it under normal conditions.

removal_confirmed_by.description: Name or ID of the person who confirmed all locks were removed.

reenergize_notified.description: Confirms all related personnel were notified of the expected re-energize time before lock/tag removal, per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §6.1.3(3)(사).

removal_timestamp.description: Timestamp when locks were removed and equipment restored.

emergency_removal.description: Present only if a lock was removed without its owner present, per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §6.3 (emergency lock removal procedure). Null under normal lock-removal conditions.

reason.description: Documented reason the emergency removal was necessary.

authorized_by.description: Supervisor/department head who authorized the emergency removal after confirming worker evacuation/safety.

signage_posted.description: Confirms warning signage/a monitor was placed at the isolation point so the returning lock owner is not exposed to an unexpected re-energized state, per §6.3.3.

tbm_ref.description: Reference to the joint Tool Box Meeting (합동 TBM) record where all involved parties (including contractors) determined the lock scope, per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §6.1.2(1) and §8.2/§8.4. May reference an _shared/tbm-record.json or domain-specific TBM record.

last_periodic_review_date.description: Date this equipment's lock/tag procedure was last reviewed, per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §9.1 (minimum annual review). Null if not yet reviewed.

risk_assessment_ref.description: Reference to the risk assessment record identifying which energy sources are hazardous for this equipment.

industry_specific_fields.description: Domain-specific extension fields (e.g., {voltage_class: '25kV'} for powergen, {gas_type: 'LNG'} for gasterm, {explosive_class: 'Class 1.1'} for defense, {radiation_source: 'Co-60'} for biotech)

legal_basis.description: Multi-source legal basis. Must cite >= 3 regulatory sources. Common cross-industry base: OSHA-KR Art.15/92 (안전보건기준에관한규칙 Art.92 — zero energy state / lockout-tagout per KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022), 산업안전보건법 Art.44 (PSM — hazardous energy isolation). Adjacent: SAPA Art.4 (safety management system obligation), SAPA Art.5 (third-party/contractor safety duty — KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022 §7.4 for contractor LOTO training). Industry-specific laws are added per the domain's legal_basis template.
examples: 안전보건기준에관한규칙 Article 92 (정비 등 작업 시 운전정지 — KOSHA GUIDE Z-40-2022)
